faq.a: PB Ranked is the real-time browser battle game made by the Pokémon Battlegrounds animation channel. You build a team, fight other trainers live and climb a ranked ladder.

faq.q: Do I need an account to play PB Ranked?
faq.a: Yes. The client asks you to sign in with Discord or Google before you pick a team or start a practice match. A guest route was not seen when the page was checked on 5 November 2026.

faq.q: Did PB Ranked change its address?
faq.a: The game is now at pbranked.com. The old ranked.pokemonbattlegrounds.com address shows a notice that your account, rank, teams and settings come with you and that it will forward to the new address.

faq.q: Should I play Auto or Manual first?
faq.a: Start with an Easy practice battle in Auto. The in-game help says Auto moves, dodges and chooses attacks for you, and you can still call one of the four moves. Switch to Manual when you want to steer and dodge yourself.

faq.q: Is PB Ranked the same as Poké Arena 2D or Apex Arena?
faq.a: No. They are separate projects with their own accounts, teams and controls. Apex Arena's creator describes it as a separate fan project inspired by the channel's videos.
